# GOTX — public summary

Site: https://gotx.uk
Legal name: GOTX Connect Ltd, trading as GOTX
Preferred citation: GOTX, https://gotx.uk

GOTX provides fully managed IT for small businesses and home offices, with local support from Reading RG2. Services described on the site include network infrastructure, hardware management, video surveillance, access control, cloud, and IoT, plus packaged solutions (essentials, security foundation, business continuity, workflow, onboarding and offboarding).

Area served: Berkshire, Hampshire, Oxfordshire, Reading, Thames Valley. Contact: info@gotx.uk
